event: Solenne lies awake in the Transition Hall from 3 AM, holding the new notification.
The party sleeps around her; the Floor 20 door stands at the far end of the hall.
The hall's light slowly brightens toward morning.
Solenne sits up and runs her morning inventory: HP full, MP full.
Solenne eats the last ration from the carry stack.
She takes out her notebook and holds it in her lap without opening it.
She watches the party instead of writing.
Dayo wakes without announcing it.
Dayo runs her morning armor check, buckle by buckle.
Dayo goes to the supply cache for her ration.
Miriam, Nadia and Vesper are still asleep around the hall.
Dayo moves back toward her pack.
Dayo stands where Miriam's path to the cache would pass close by her.
Solenne recalls Dayo learning that positioning lesson the hard way on Floor 7.
Solenne reads Dayo for one full Conductor read and looks away.
Tomás comes back from scouting the floor entry before most are awake.
Tomás adds two lines to his preliminary notes without sitting down.
Tomás announces the morning brief in twenty minutes.
Tomás sits down and keeps writing.
Nadia wakes up.
Miriam makes her three-line morning entry in the clinical notebook.
Vesper begins packing for Floor 20 entry.
Nadia checks the dulcimer, now including the new strap's attachment points.
Nadia does not play; she puts the dulcimer back and fastens the case.
With everyone present, Tomás begins the brief on his notation surface.
Tomás describes Floor 20, the Crystal Salt Desert: salt flats, crystal spires, harsh light.
Tomás names Saltback Predators as the main threat: surface ambush, crystalline hide.
Tomás describes the Saltback tell: a quarter-second of the surface doing something wrong.
Tomás pauses, deciding how to word the next thing.
Nadia's finger sounds the dulcimer's lowest string; one faint note fades.
Tomás reports Resonant Stalkers, Level 18-19, tracking bond-aura at 60 meters.
Tomás says their density is above what the documentation suggests, and ends the brief.
Solenne sees he has released what he held since last night, and does not ask.
Vesper runs her supply cache inventory.
Vesper reaches the in-progress section of her carry stack.
Vesper sets an in-progress project in the upper-middle of the stack, not the bottom.
Solenne counts four in-progress items moved into Vesper's visible range.
Solenne looks away before Vesper looks up.
Miriam sits against the wall with her clinical notebook open, not writing.
Miriam rereads her Floor 19 margin note about asking for the Mana Vial.
Solenne keeps her own notebook closed.
Mid-morning, Brennan messages that he can share intel on Floor 20.
Brennan of Team Ironwall comes into the hall; Hex stays at the back with his party.
Brennan says the party has changed since its formation trouble on Floor 13.
Brennan warns of a formal Apex contact faction approach in two to three weeks.
Solenne asks what the faction wants.
Brennan says access and proof that Harmony mechanics can be reproduced.
Solenne asks about Floor 20.
Brennan has logged four Resonant Stalker encounters at 55-60 meters; they don't break off.
Solenne thanks him.
Brennan goes back to his party.
Solenne stands weighing the Apex deadline against telling the party today.
In an alcove, Vesper gets a message from Prita and replies she needs a few minutes.
Solenne moves away to give Vesper space.
Vesper sits in silent exchange, hands still, Workframe off.
Prita asks how handing it over felt; Vesper answers, "Different."
Prita asks her to show where the words end; Vesper lets "different" stand.
Vesper comes out with her carry stack complete and goes to her pre-floor check.
Solenne does not ask; Vesper's Workframe stays quiet the rest of the morning.
The party finishes preparing: armor done, notes stowed, dulcimer case on Nadia's back.
Solenne watches them all, still holding the notification: 109 of 150.
Solenne pictures telling them at the rest floor and knows she decided long ago.
The Tower's light reaches its full morning quality.
Nadia tests the dulcimer case on her back for two steps, then walks on.
Solenne picks up her pack and says, "Okay. Let's go."
The party walks toward the already-open door at the hall's end.
They step onto Floor 20, the Crystal Salt Desert, bright crystal rising from salt flat.
Tomás calls formation three and the party takes it.
The door closes behind them.
